★Request
Hide character

...The true girl inside holds fierce, passionate feelings
toward victory—toward becoming the "lead protagonist."

What happened all of a sudden...!?
Please, lift your head up...!

I can't win...! I have to maintain top speed longer...
or it won't even be a contest...! But why—... Aaaaahhh!!

I lift my head, look straight into her eyes, and lay everything bare.
The impressions I once had. What I truly felt when I scouted her.

And so, with renewed resolve, I took my first step
alongside her toward the mock race that would decide our fate—

Until then, my own presence had always felt vague and hazy,
but in that moment, it was as if my true self had been vividly cast into the world—a profound, stirring emotion.

If I failed to keep my promise, I had already found
a successor trainer and arranged for them to take care of her.

I'm in their field of view, but I'm nothing special...
And because I'm not special, I can never be number one...

That I can stand and fight alongside girls like Pokke-chan...
That I'm an umamusume who can become a "lead protagonist"...!
———I want to be the "lead protagonist."

In that case... I accept your resolve too.
I will win, no matter what. And I will prove it...!

The very first time I felt that way...
was that unforgettable day when I stood in the center for the first time.

What Dantsu Flame needed was a trainer who could lead her to victory.
If I couldn't prove that I was that person, I had no right to stand beside her.

With those opening words, I bowed my head deeply to Dantsu Flame.
To apologize for my lack of respect toward her until now.

——............I understand.
So that's how serious you are, Trainer.

Dantsu Flame crosses the finish line!
The winner is Dantsu Flame!!

...Every time I lost touch with my friends, I thought:
I'm just a forgettable, insubstantial person with nothing memorable about me.

Every plan written here...
was completely meaningless, drawn up by someone who hadn't truly stood by her at all.

At this academy, there are so many girls with incredible talent...
who are born to be "lead protagonists" right from the start.

Because of my father's work, I transferred schools a lot when I was little.
Making friends in a new place was never that difficult, but—

The sight I saw that day from the center of the podium, clutching my medal.
That dazzling moment... when it felt like everyone saw me as someone special.

Really...!
I promise you, I'll definitely win...!

T-That's not what I mean...!
Terminating our contract, please don't say that...!
Huh—

In order to truly walk beside her as her trainer,
this was an absolute necessity that had to be fulfilled. Therefore—

I want to stand in the center again...!
I want to become a brighter, unforgettable "lead protagonist" in everyone's hearts...!
Even so... even if that's true...!

Fortunately, someone with far more experience and a better track record than me agreed to help.
Under their guidance, there was no doubt she would be steadily and securely led forward.
Whoa...! Amazing...!!

I'll prove it...! That I'm ready to debut...!
That I can aim to be the "lead protagonist"!! —Yaaahhhh!!

But when I was running... during a race, it was completely different.
That moment I crossed the line in first place... I was the "lead protagonist"...!
Trainer...—

If you're not number one, you leave no lasting impression on anyone.
And just like that, you're forgotten... Just a "side character."

The truth was that not once until today
had I ever truly aimed for the "lead role" alongside her.

(...Even Trainer must think
that I could never become a "lead protagonist.")

(And yet, I couldn't win...!
I wasn't good enough, I couldn't reach them...!!)

(———Girls like Pokke-chan and Tachyon-chan, who are born to be "lead protagonists,"
would easily win even in the Selection Race...!)
Then, does that mean I can run in the mock race...!

“*Sigh*... The letters stopped coming again...
...I guess it can't be helped. Everyone forgets eventually...—”

When I worked so desperately hard and made it into Tracen Academy, I was overjoyed.
Thinking that now, I could finally become a "lead protagonist" on the grand stage.

...Um. I'm still nowhere close to being a lead protagonist, but...
even so... I look forward to working with you!
——Yaaahhh!!

...Every time I see that brilliance, it hits me.
I'm still nowhere close to being a true "lead protagonist."
We didn't win, did we? The Selection Race.

That gentle, sunlit warmth she showed when we first met.
I had mistaken that for the very essence of Dantsu Flame.
I don't want... to give up...!

Incredible talent...! Your future is looking bright, you truly shone out there!
Congratulations! You're going to grow up to be an amazing umamusume!

*Pant*... *pant*... *pant*...
No... No, this isn't good enough! At this rate, not at all...!!

Burning just like a blazing flame.
...That fiery figure was the true Dantsu Flame———
——...But I realized it right away.

...Picking up Dantsu Flame's future training plan lying on the desk,
I draw a large 'X' right across it.
............A few days later.
